question: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_status
    FROM olist_orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        d.order_id,
        op.payment_value
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN olist_order_payments op ON d.order_id = op.order_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        c.customer_city,
        c.customer_state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS delivered_order_count,
        AVG(cp.payment_value) AS avg_payment_value
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN olist_customers c ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN customer_payments cp ON d.order_id = cp.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_city, c.customer_state
)
SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    delivered_order_count,
    ROUND(avg_payment_value, 2) AS avg_payment_value,
    customer_city,
    customer_state
FROM customer_stats
ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC
LIMIT 3
